verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI ('Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line') with an explicit dedicated docs page, and separately documents AI-native usage instructing coding agents to install and use the Stripe CLI (npm i -g @stripe/cli) to provision sandboxes without human account setup, plus an official MCP server and agent skills repo for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's AI-native usage and no evidence of version-pinning or agent-specific CLI subcommand documentation beyond the sandbox example.
